title: VITA 49.2 bridge
desc: VITA 49.2 UDP bridge: RX export (CS16 signal data + IF context), TX ingest and 49.2 command/ack control on UDP 4991. Machine-facing; TX ingest obeys the board TX policy (three gates, fail-safe none). No idle-stop: UDP consumers hold no connection - release the lease explicitly.

data.desc: VRT signal data + context out; TX data + command packets in
